source: Gwanmesia, Wang, Heady and Liebermann (2014), Elasticity and sound velocities of polycrystalline grossular garnet (Ca3Al2Si3O12) at simultaneous high pressures and high temperatures, Physics of the Earth and Planetary Interiors 228, 80-87, Table 1
source_version: Final primary publisher full HTML, Table 1 and associated methods/caption; full text accessible through institutional connection. PDF download did not complete; no primary PDF claimed.
preservation: All 624 literal numerical cells including trailing decimal zeros preserved. FNV-1a32 of newline-joined, comma-separated data rows, excluding header, including the terminal newline, matched publisher DOM extraction: c93742ca.
temperature_conversion: T_K = original T_C + 273.15; the ten room-temperature rows are 30 C = 303.15 K, not 300 K. Seven remaining groups at 127, 227, 327, 427, 527, 627 and 727 C contain six rows each.
error_qualification: These are source-reported estimates, not reconstructed per-row standard deviations. Density estimates differ between caption and later text and are both retained. The maximum volume uncertainty is not a per-row error. Confidence level, cross-coordinate covariance and numerical temperature errors are unspecified.
derived_quantity_dependencies: Length inferred using (V/V0)^(1/3); density from volume; velocities from length and transit times; L=rho*Vp^2, G=rho*Vs^2, KS=L-4G/3. Correlated derived quantities must not be counted as independent observations.
angel_selection: S1 retains 52 KS constraints and excludes all 52 XRD volume constraints. Source parameter 54 multiplies calculated KS by 1.00551 for comparison on the observed scale. No excluded volume constraint added.
rights: Attribution retained for factual numerical observations. Source licensing unspecified here; no publisher text, figures or files redistributed. Contributor dedication, if applicable, does not license the publication.
